prompt:
WeChat article cover image, subject: 微信这个点赞设计，藏着成年人最不敢说的社交真相 — 你有没有过这种时刻。

深夜刷朋友圈，看到一条特别触动你的内容。可能是老同学晒了张十年前的合照，可能是前同事发了段离职感言，也可能是某个亲戚终于搬进了新房。

你想说点什么，又觉得说什么都轻了。于是你点了个赞。

然后系统弹出一行小字：轻点两下取消赞。

你愣了半秒。原来一个赞，点出去容易，收回来也只需要两下。可有些话一旦说出口，两下是收不回来的。

微信这个设计挺有意思。点赞只给你一次机会，取消. Clean minimalist business cover, solid or subtle gradient background, lots of white space, bold modern Chinese typography as the visual focus, no decorative elements, professional and elegant, editorial magazine style. CRITICAL RULES: Do NOT include any text, letters, Chinese characters, or watermarks in the image. Do NOT generate overly smooth, plastic-like, or hyper-saturated AI-art style. Aim for photorealistic or high-quality editorial illustration style. Natural lighting, natural textures, subtle imperfections are preferred. Avoid shiny/glossy effects. Avoid rainbow gradients. Avoid 3D rendered look. The image should look like it was taken by a professional photographer or designed by a human graphic designer.
